next_step_summary: PR #311 adds Concept Lexicon v0.2 as the third Expert Memory learning layer. It consolidates all 30 historical ontology candidates, current SECURITY cards, DOCUMENT_REFERENCE and REPAIR_COST_RECOVERY decisions, and Mechanism Map v0.2 audit distinctions into 47 top-level teaching concepts plus 10 reusable temporal roles. Concepts are classified by kind and include definition, essential slots, relations, do-not-confuse boundaries, and evidence boundaries. TENANT_REPAIR_RECOVERY is retained as a historical specialization of generalized REPAIR_COST_RECOVERY; INSTITUTIONAL_GUARANTEE remains a SECURITY concept rather than a new Router family. New explicit concepts cover party roles/object/letting-entitlement claims, document status/reference/precedence/external proceedings, payment channel, external value linkage, condition protocol, alterations/improvement disposition, generalized termination, set-off, and dispute forum. Learning Strategy and Mechanism Map now identify the knowledge hierarchy as Foundation Core -> Mechanism Map -> Concept Lexicon -> detailed modules/examples -> verified legal overlays, while operational routing still loads only relevant lexicon slices. The old 30-concept inventory remains a historical research snapshot. This remains documentation/research only: no Router schema, extraction schema, Gold labels, runtime rules, statutory authority, provider use or privacy boundary changes. Next, evaluate fresh concealed synthetic clauses in a separate model context, count omissions/excess routes and test linked-clause retrieval without sending real contracts to an external provider. Direct RC PDF identity and canonical TF_C linkage remain UNKNOWN.
